models_evaluated: convolutional neural network for bacterial vs fungal keratitis classification

links.outcome: CNN AUROC/AUPRC across five corneal photograph quality parameters (gaze, eyelid, exposure, focus, light reflection)
links.effect: Light reflection or eyelids obscuring the cornea were each linked to significantly higher CNN performance. No other quality parameter significantly influenced performance. Expert-level performance was reported regardless of image quality.
links.quote: The CNN demonstrated expert-level performance regardless of image quality.

screen.reason: Evaluates how specific input image quality factors affect CNN diagnostic performance on retrospective clinical photographs of infectious keratitis, but does not test an organizational deployment practice or guardrail.
